ruleset: No set-aside, held groups or joining a group to the board (aside 0).
Flip (swap top and bottom edges) is free, any piece, any number of times (flip1 0).
You may place on any cell where the edges fit (must 0); the creature must link; passing is free (freepass).
Links: a knob in a hole of the same family; flat fits but never links; Mud blocks links. A chain fires the placed piece then everything linked.
Fire order by type: environment, Guard/Soothe, Trick, Hurt/Charm, Heal/Item; Quick first, Heavy last then gone.
Combos (Ambush, Riposte, Bait ...) read the whole chain of one side, and creature chains get them too.
Your pieces fired in the creature's chain work for you; creature pieces fired in your chain work for it.
A chain of 3+ uses up every piece that fired; creature pieces fall away after 2 firings (boss and Guard/Hold 3).
The whole hand is redrawn each round (redraw 1); only Keeper pieces stay.
The aim is shown free: piece, cell, total damage, guard it eats, combos, which of your pieces it fires, its reason.
Taking the aim cell (or breaking its fit) only reroutes it at full strength (aimhit 0).
Birds show a second aim, bosses show and commit their next piece, a boss AOE is marked a turn ahead.
The environment's next pieces (kinds) are shown face up in the Next strip; only their landing cell (random, empty) is hidden.
Creature abilities, play style and status (guard, evade, thorns, bash, poison) are shown; its hand and draw are hidden.
No free spawned creature piece (spawn 0); a pal piece already knocks off the creature's strongest piece up to its value.
Creature Ambush ability: only its first Hurt of its first turn.

tiers.10: First tells: a laid trap, its fallback move, a soft spot.
tiers.15: Reading the ground: where the weather lands, its combos called off, its set-ups knocked down.
tiers.20: Seeing ahead: its next move locked in, a real pit, guards that take its hits off the board.
tiers.25: Hidden ways: a secret cell, its committed piece thrown out, a field of unseen snares.
tiers.30: Nothing hidden: its whole hand, its chain turned on it, a permanent weak spot.

summary: Sharp Eye is the seed: see the piece after its aim and blunt it. Every Sense piece adds what the free aim chip and Next strip do not show (Second Guess, Lay of the Land, Long Look, Eyes of the Wood), lays a trap on the route the shown aim will take (Tripwire, Pitfall, Snare Field, Turnabout), or cancels and punishes its set-ups and marks weak spots (Not Fooled, Turn the Tables, Beat It To It, Saw It Coming, Soft Spot, Chink in the Bark). Sense rewards reading the creature, not your own chain, dice or tempo.
question: Sharp Eye's held text says 'you see the creature's next aim', which v1 already shows for free; should it read just 'you see the piece it plays after its aim' (which Long Look then locks in)?

pieces.name: Tripwire
pieces.text: Each time it fires in a chain that holds a creature piece, the creature's strongest piece loses {a} and its next Hurt does half damage.
pieces.worth_it: A laid trap: it pays when the creature's chain runs through it, and the aim chip already tells you when its committed move will fire your piece.
pieces.changes_play: You place it on the route the shown aim will link through, not where your own chain wants it.
pieces.risk: Springs every firing while it stays; guard rail: half damage is a max (never stacks), shrink hits one piece per firing, normal piece life and use-up apply.
pieces.engine_cost: none (cfoe, shrink:a, fhalf:1; your pieces' clauses already fire in the creature's chain, pfb_fire calls pfb_wx_fire for every piece of yours).
pieces.motif: Edge: a thin taut thread with a tiny bell knot. Fire: the thread snaps tight, the bell jingles and the creature piece jolts.
pieces.change_note: Dropped the 'Sticky' tag (Sticky is a modifier in v1, not a tag); text says it springs on each firing and leans on the free aim chip.

pieces.name: Second Guess
pieces.text: Held: the aim chip also shows where the creature goes if you take its aim cell. Played: if it has to pick again this turn, it plays that shown second choice, and that piece loses {a}.
pieces.worth_it: Blocking the aim is free but today the re-pick is unseen and just as strong; this shows the fallback and pins the creature to it at a discount.
pieces.changes_play: Blocking stops being a blind reroute: you choose to block knowing exactly where the hit goes next.
pieces.risk: Could make blocking always right; guard rail: the second choice is computed once at intent (no new search), the cut is once, Sense's held effect only while it is in hand.
pieces.engine_cost: small: in pfb_intent compute a second aim with pfb_search(avoid = aim cell) like the Bird's 'alt'; show it while held; on reaim play it (aimforce) and apply wnx a.
pieces.motif: Edge: two little footprints pointing different ways. Fire: a faint second red mark blinks on, the first fades, a thought bubble pops.
pieces.change_note: Replaced Wary Ear: its cut copied Sharp Eye's played effect and its Ambush cancel only mattered in the creature's first turn.

pieces.name: Soft Spot
pieces.value: v = 2 + stat/10; a = 1 + stat/5; b = ceil(a/2)
pieces.text: Pierce. If the creature has guard up, it loses {a} guard. Your next Hurt this fight gets +{b}.
pieces.worth_it: Marks a weak spot: the guard a creature built on its turn (it stays through yours) is broken now and the next Hurt is set up.
pieces.changes_play: Guard-heavy creatures become a two-beat rhythm: mark, then strike.
pieces.risk: Stacks with other Pierce pieces; guard rail: the strip needs guard up, the bonus is one Hurt only.
pieces.motif: Edge: a small chalk X on the knob. Fire: a chalk circle draws on the creature's bark and cracks it.

pieces.name: Lay of the Land
pieces.text: Keeper. Held: the Next strip also marks the cell each environment piece will land on. Played: the first Next piece goes to the bottom of the environment's deck and a new one takes its place.
pieces.worth_it: The strip already shows WHICH environment pieces come, but they land on a random empty cell; knowing the cell lets you build a chain that will link to the Sun or keep clear of the Bramble.
pieces.changes_play: You plan a round ahead around where the ground will change, and can send away a drop that would hurt you.
pieces.risk: Could feel like a free slot; guard rail: Keeper uses a hand place each round it waits, the cell is pre-rolled and falls back to random if it gets filled.
pieces.engine_cost: small: pre-roll x,y for each entry in env 'next' at pfb_env_draw (pfb_env_place uses it if still free); played: move env next[0] to the bottom of env draw and refill.
pieces.motif: Edge: a folded map corner. Fire: the map unfolds over the board and a tiny pin drops on the cell where the next piece will land.
pieces.change_note: Seeing the next environment piece is already free (the Next strip); now it shows the landing cell, which is random and hidden, and the played swap replaces the old one.

pieces.name: Not Fooled
pieces.text: Guard. The creature's next chain gets no combos: no Ambush, Bait or Riposte for it.
pieces.worth_it: Creature chains get combos from the whole chain, and the aim chip names the combo it is about to land; this cancels exactly that.
pieces.changes_play: You read 'combo Ambush' on the aim chip and answer it, instead of only blocking the hit.
pieces.risk: Dead against creatures that never combo; guard rail: one chain only, its piece values are untouched.
pieces.engine_cost: small: a foe flag 'nocombo' that skips pfb_set_combo for who = foe, cleared at the end of its turn.
pieces.motif: Edge: a raised eyebrow arc. Fire: the creature's combo label appears, then is crossed out with a shake of the head.

pieces.name: Turn the Tables
pieces.value: v = 3 + stat/10; a = 1 + stat/5; b = ceil(a/2)
pieces.text: A creature Trick or Guard linked to it does not fire for the creature in this chain, and is knocked off the board afterwards. Deal {b} more if it did.
pieces.worth_it: Its Trick and Guard pieces are the partners of Ambush, Bait and Riposte; this takes them off before they pay out and stops them firing for it in your chain.
pieces.changes_play: You aim your Hurts into its set-ups instead of away from them; reading the board beats raw damage.
pieces.risk: Could clear a 3x3 board; guard rail: one linked Trick or Guard only, not a boss's piece; pal targeting is separate (strongest piece, any type).
pieces.engine_cost: small: a 'link:trick/guard' foe check (link exists, add a by-foe filter), skip that piece in pfb_fire and push it to wkn (knock).
pieces.motif: Edge: a hook that curls back on itself. Fire: the creature tile turns face down and drops away as the hit lands.
pieces.change_note: A creature piece linked into your chain fires for the creature today; it now does not fire, then is knocked off, so the punish is clean.

pieces.name: Long Look
pieces.text: For the rest of the fight you see the piece the creature plays after its aim, and it is held to it: next round it must play that piece.
pieces.worth_it: Only great creatures commit two turns ahead; this makes any creature predictable a round early, so traps and guards can be laid in advance.
pieces.changes_play: You set Pitfall, Tripwire or a Guard a round before the hit, knowing what is coming.
pieces.risk: Overlaps Sharp Eye's held view; guard rail: Sharp Eye only shows (while held), Long Look commits it; once a fight, no value of its own.
pieces.engine_cost: small: turn on the boss 'Two turns' path (plan.next and nextk in pfb_intent) with a per-fight flag.
pieces.motif: Edge: a long spyglass tube. Fire: the spyglass extends and a ghost piece settles behind the aim mark.
pieces.change_note: 'See its next two moves' was Sharp Eye's held effect (the aim is already free) and its cut copied Sharp Eye; now it also locks the second move in.

pieces.name: Pitfall
pieces.text: Stays 2 more rounds. The first creature Hurt that is placed linked to it fires for nothing and falls away; then Pitfall is spent.
pieces.worth_it: A real trap: one creature Hurt wasted entirely, and a committed aim that links to it walks straight in.
pieces.changes_play: You place it next to the shown aim cell with fitting edges: the aim still plays and drops in.
pieces.risk: Could lock 3x3 boards; guard rail: one Hurt only, then gone; it fires nothing for you; the creature's search avoids it like a Bramble.
pieces.engine_cost: medium: a check in pfb_place for foe (new piece is a Hurt linked to a Pitfall): zero its value, knock it and the Pitfall after the chain; life via existing 'life' act.
pieces.motif: Edge: a dark hole with leaf cover. Fire: the leaves drop, the creature piece tumbles in with a puff of dust.
pieces.change_note: Dropped the 'Sticky' tag (not a v1 tag; life now via the life act) and said it springs when the piece is placed, before item rank would fire it last.

pieces.name: Saw It Coming
pieces.text: Hold. Each creature Hurt this guard blocks is knocked off the board and its next piece loses {a}.
pieces.worth_it: Guarding where you know it will strike cleans its board and blunts its follow-up.
pieces.changes_play: Rewards guarding against the shown aim; it thins the pieces its later chains need.
pieces.risk: A long-held guard removing every hit; guard rail: the cut is a max, removal only on a real block.
pieces.motif: Edge: a small open eye on the shield rim. Fire: the eye blinks as the hit lands and the creature tile shatters.

pieces.name: Hidden Path
pieces.text: Placed on the edge: opens a hidden cell beyond it for 3 rounds. Only you can place there, and it links to Hidden Path.
pieces.worth_it: Board space the creature cannot use or aim at; on a cramped 3x3 board that is a whole extra move.
pieces.changes_play: Your chains get a safe pocket outside its reach; the edge becomes a door.
pieces.risk: Breaks board-size balance; guard rail: one hidden cell, 3 rounds, creature and environment pieces never go there.
pieces.engine_cost: large: one cell outside w x h for one owner (render, fit, link, preview, expire).
pieces.motif: Edge: a gap in the hedge with a lantern. Fire: the hedge parts and a mossy cell slides out from the board's edge.

pieces.name: Beat It To It
pieces.value: v = 2 + stat/10; a = 1 + stat/5; b = ceil(a/2)
pieces.text: Next to the creature's aim: its aimed piece is thrown out of its hand, it picks again from the rest, and you deal {b} plus half that piece's value.
pieces.worth_it: Taking the aim cell only reroutes the same piece at full strength; this removes the piece itself, so the threat you saw is truly gone.
pieces.changes_play: The aim becomes a target: you knock its best committed piece out and force a weaker hand.
pieces.risk: Overlaps Sidestep; guard rail: it still plays a turn (no skip), once per creature turn, a boss's forced next piece is not thrown out.
pieces.engine_cost: medium: aimnext check, move the plan piece to foe discard, clear the plan (it re-searches), damage from plan v.
pieces.motif: Edge: a pointed finger. Fire: your hit flashes on the aim mark; the ghost piece crumples and blows away.
pieces.change_note: 'It must choose again' is already free (take the aim cell); now the aimed piece itself leaves its hand, so the re-pick cannot reuse it.

pieces.name: Snare Field
pieces.value: v = 1 + stat/10; a = 1 + stat/5; b = ceil(a/2)
pieces.text: Up to {b} empty cells next to it become snares for 2 rounds; a creature piece placed on one loses half its value. The creature cannot see them.
pieces.worth_it: Area denial plus a big cut; if its committed aim cell becomes a snare, the aim still lands there.
pieces.changes_play: You fence the board around the shown aim; your read of its layout decides the fight.
pieces.risk: Too much denial on 3x3; guard rail: max {b} cells, 2 rounds, the creature's search ignores them (it cannot see them).
pieces.engine_cost: medium: a snare mark per cell (like the ground map pfb_ter) and a halve on creature place.
pieces.motif: Edge: a coiled loop of twine. Fire: little loops spring from the piece to its neighbouring cells and glint.

pieces.name: Eyes of the Wood
pieces.text: Keeper. Held: you see the creature's whole hand and the piece it draws next, and every piece it aims loses {a}.
pieces.worth_it: Its hand is the one thing the game hides; seeing it plus a steady cut on every committed move is total foresight.
pieces.changes_play: You stop guessing: every round is solved against its real options; the cost is a hand place each round.
pieces.risk: Information aura is very strong; guard rail: only while held (Keeper), the cut is the aimed piece only.
pieces.engine_cost: medium: send foe hand and draw top in pfb_view while held; set foe wnx a at each pfb_intent.
pieces.motif: Edge: leaf eyes along the border. Fire: eyes open among the board's leaves and the creature's hand fans out face up.
pieces.change_note: Dropped 'the next two environment pieces' (the Next strip shows them free); added the creature's next draw.

pieces.name: Turnabout
pieces.text: Guard. The next creature chain that fires it: its Trick, Hurt and Heal pieces fire for you instead (its Hurts hit it, its heals heal you).
pieces.worth_it: The ultimate punish: its whole set-up, Ambush combo included, becomes your turn.
pieces.changes_play: You lay it where the shown aim's chain must pass and let it build into you.
pieces.risk: Huge swing on big boards; guard rail: once, then spent; values halved against a boss; its Guards still fire for it.
pieces.engine_cost: large: swap the owner of creature pieces that fire after it in one chain in pfb_fire, combos included.
pieces.motif: Edge: a curling arrow. Fire: the creature's tiles turn your colour one by one as the chain runs back.
pieces.change_note: Chains now fire by type (Guard before Trick, Hurt, Heal), so 'pieces after it in the chain' is now said by type.

pieces.name: Chink in the Bark
pieces.text: Pierce. Marks its cell for the rest of the fight: every Hurt you place on or next to it pierces and gets +{a}.
pieces.worth_it: A permanent weak spot that turns one corner of the board into your kill zone.
pieces.changes_play: The whole fight bends around a spot; the creature can contest it by placing there.
pieces.risk: Permanent stacking bonus; guard rail: one mark per fight (a new one moves it), flat {a}.
pieces.engine_cost: small: a marked cell in state and a check where your Hurt value is set in pfb_fire.
pieces.motif: Edge: a split in bark with a glint. Fire: a crack of light opens in the cell and stays faintly lit.
